[Q45 English repeat from page 15]
46- How many covalent bonds are there between Carbon-carbon atoms in ethyne?
(A) 1 (B) 2 (C) 3 (D) 3
47- Which of the following is the most reactive halogen?
(A) F (B) Cl (C) Br (D) I
48- How many periods are there in the periodic table?
(A) 5 (B) 6 (C) 7 (D) 8

notes: Q46 English option (D) is printed as '3', duplicating option (C); Hindi block correctly shows '4'. Print typo, transcribed exactly as shown — Hindi is source of truth (correct answer is 4, ethyne has a triple bond = 1 sigma + 2 pi = technically the question likely means total covalent bonds; either way Hindi (D)=4 is the intended distinct 4th option).
